answer: A kabaddi league registration with season appearance record works as the gate: appearances logged with one league across seasons. Each of 260 aliases needs its own appearance records, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The pulse test is the price tag: 260 fakes mean 260 payments. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The thread signal is visible to every grader, and the river ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
